description: Remove a line item from an order. Recomputes the order total. Only allowed while the order is pending or confirmed; otherwise it fails with 409 CONFLICT "Order lines can only be changed while the order is pending or confirmed". Use get_order to find the order's externalId and the item's itemId. The result echoes the operating workspace.

externalId.description: The order externalId returned by list_orders or create_order.

itemId.description: The order item id returned by get_order.

name: remove_order_item
title: Remove order item
